05 Before your demo

Good questions.
Clear next steps.

Tell us how your firm handles documents today. We’ll use that workflow as the starting point.

Get in touch
Who forwards documents to FirmVault?

Employees forward documents to FirmVault’s WhatsApp number. That product intake channel is separate from the sales email used to arrange a demo.

How are documents filed?

Documents are organised by client, service, document type, and period. During the demo, we’ll show how filing details are assigned in the product and discuss how that fits your team’s process.

Does every document go through Pending?

No. Pending is for unclassified documents that need their filing details reviewed. It is a conditional review path, not a missing-document tracker.

What will we see during the demo?

We’ll walk through employee forwarding, the four filing details, Pending review, and central search and retrieval, using your firm’s current process to guide the conversation.

Can we discuss our team’s requirements?

Yes. Bring questions about file types, search, team access, onboarding, and support. We’ll discuss the product’s current capabilities and the arrangements your firm needs.

Are these screenshots of the live product?

No. The visuals and interactive vault are illustrative website examples with fictional records. They explain the document workflow; a demo is the next step to see the actual product.

What happens when I request a demo?

The demo page prepares an email to contact@nexosk.in. You send it from your email app, and our team coordinates a time with you. Preparing the message does not reserve an appointment.
